title: Qwen3.8 27B IQ3_XXS on one RTX 5060 Ti 16GB
purpose: Single-card 64K high-context Qwen3.8 route with q8 KV and built-in MTP.
caveats: One request slot on one GPU. Not a concurrency recommendation.
The model emits substantial hidden reasoning; sustained evidence was measured with reasoning preserved and a client-visible final answer required.

64K is the highest useful tier validated on this route. On this exact one-card setup, 64K and 96K f16 KV failed to allocate, and 96K q8 failed while creating the MTP context. Not a maximum-context claim.
